review: Fresh fixture replay passed all 2048 cases and 4096 original helper invocations. The independent sequential oracle applies the configuration writes and then the original disable routine; comparisons cover the peripheral page and local RAM outside the documented 4-byte stack exclusion. The disable result is R0=0 and R1 equals the final whole word with only bit 0 cleared; bit 31 and the other configuration bits are preserved. Null configuration and ordinary-memory aliases at 0x40004048 and 0x40004050 are represented.
limitations: The selected peripheral aliases are ordinary RAM backing, not physical clock semantics.
No general fault, alias, or concurrency coverage.
Partial/unaccepted; no admission, global coverage, or gate promotion.
